build_coco_panoptic_dataset: build a COCO panoptic segmentation dataset for train or val splits using the build function
create_coco_panoptic_instance: create a CocoPanoptic dataset instance with image folder, annotation folder, and annotation file paths
get_item_from_coco_panoptic: get an image and its panoptic segmentation target dictionary by index from the dataset
get_height_and_width: get the height and width of an image at a given index from the COCO panoptic dataset
review_coco_panoptic_class: review the CocoPanoptic class to understand panoptic segmentation data loading and mask processing
